newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's October tax collection improves - minister.
newsitem.headline: Russia's October tax collection improves - minister.

text.p: First Deputy Finance Minister Vladimir Petrov said on Thursday the state received 10.6 trillion roubles of taxes in the second half of October after about three trillion in the first half, Itar-Tass news agency said.

Low tax collection is one of Russia's most serious problems, and the International Monetary Fund, concerned about its impact on fiscal policy, has delayed payment of the next tranche of Russia's IMF $10 billion loan. An IMF mission will come to Moscow in November to discuss the issue.
Petrov told a cabinet meeting he was sure Russia would receive the next $350 million tranche by the end of the year.
